answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 5323 Country: India Title: I am working in a software company in testing branch , currently i am working in Data warehousing testing(Deals with historical data,information of a company for its future growth) for a particular bank ,my work is to test whether the data (old and new)stores and check for the status of particular period of time what is the growth of the company and all whether it is halal , please suggest me. Question: Assalamu alaikum mufti sahib, I am working in a software company in testing branch , currently i am working in Data warehousing testing(Deals with historical data,information of a company for its future growth) for a particular bank ,my work is to test whether the data (old and new)stores and check for the status of particular period of time what is the growth of the company and all whether it is halal , please suggest me. Answer ID: 5323 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1071/1005=D/1429) You work of Data Warehousing Testing is lawful in itself and its income is halal . But, working the same for bank is not free from being undesirable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
